'''Ferrin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House of Thul]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and a cousin of [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Kendoh Thul]]. In [[3643 BBY]] Ferrin and fellow Count [[Marcum]] had a holoconversation with [[Duke/Legends|Duke]], in which Ferrin called his cousin an abomination.
